answer: Picture the agent graph as a walnut cross-section: honest identities branch outward along separate funding ridges, but a sybil operator running one inference pipeline behind many masks leaves every mask drawing from the same wallet and invite-edge, collapsing onto a single basalt-hard seam. The protocol scores each new account by how much of its funding path and vouch graph overlaps existing nodes; high overlap caps reward accrual near zero. To look independent the attacker must fund and warm distinct, unlinked capital for every mask, turning cheap forks into a real per-identity cost.
